name: P07 — the on-screen panel: click real buttons, prove the demo is playable by hand.

steps.note: P0. The panel builds itself off the live cast[] on the first update, and every entry is a real <button>.

steps.msg: every entry is a real button, not a div

steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button.entry')].map(e => e.textContent); return { count: b.length, roster: b.filter(t => !['idle','walk','run','turn','talk','nod','surprised','celebrate','attack','cast','hurt','sit','sleep','kneel','grieve','wave','surprised','happy','sad','angry','love','question','sweat','sleepy','music','◂ low','high ▸','– out','in +','⟲','⟳'].includes(t)) }; })()

steps.note: P1. Click Barty's button. Same code path a person uses — a click event on the button, not __DQ.show().

steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button.entry')].find(e => e.textContent === 'Barty'); if (!b) return { ok: false, why: 'no Barty button' }; b.click(); return { ok: true, clicked: b.textContent }; })()
(() => { const s = document.querySelector('#panel button.entry.sel'); return { selected: s && s.textContent, title: document.getElementById('t-name').textContent }; })()

steps.note: P2. A clip button and a camera knob, the same way.

steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button.entry')].find(e => e.textContent === 'wave'); b.click(); return true; })()
(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button.entry')].find(e => e.textContent === 'in +'); b.click(); b.click(); return __DQ.cameraZoom(); })()

steps.note: P3. Hide the panel for a clean frame, then bring it back.

steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button.entry')].find(e => e.textContent === 'Hide panel'); b.click(); return { hidden: document.getElementById('panel').hidden, label: b.textContent }; })()
(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button.entry')].find(e => e.textContent === 'Show panel'); b.click(); return { hidden: document.getElementById('panel').hidden }; })()

steps.note: P4. The farmer, the widest brim on the roster — the frame that decided the level camera.

steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button.entry')].find(e => e.textContent === 'Farmer'); b.click(); return document.getElementById('t-name').textContent; })()
